Meghan Markle’s estranged father arrested after child abuse material investigation
By Molly Grace • Published: 07 Nov 2026 • 0:38 • 3 minutes read
The allegations have caused distress for Meghan. Photo credit: FiledIMAGE/Shutterstock
Thomas Markle, the estranged father of the Duchess of Sussex, has been arrested in Florida and charged with possessing child sexual abuse material after investigators searched two storage units in California. The case began with a disturbing discovery among his belongings in the Philippines, reportedly made by a family member, and has now become a federal investigation involving the FBI.
Markle, 82, was taken into custody on Friday, November 6, and faces one federal count of possession of child pornography. Prosecutors say officers seized around 78 items from the two storage units, including slides, film negatives and books containing suspected abuse material. The allegations have caused further distress for Meghan, who has previously said she kept her father away from her children to protect them.
FBI traced the investigation to two storage units
According to the criminal complaint, US investigators received information in October from witnesses about suspected material among Markle’s possessions in the Philippines. One person had signed an affidavit describing its discovery, while another told the FBI that Markle rented a storage unit in the Los Angeles area. Agents obtained search warrants and examined two units registered to Markle. He had rented both since 2008 and had continued paying for them, with the latest payments made in October this year, according to the Justice Department.
The FBI seized approximately 27 items from one unit and 51 from the second. The materials included slides, film negatives and books. The affidavit says investigators identified suspected child sexual abuse images among the film negatives and describes photographs which they allege show Markle with prepubescent girls. A witness who had known him since the 1970s identified the adult man in two images as Markle, according to the court document.
The investigation is continuing and the material has not all been reviewed. The affidavit says agents had identified around 18 suspected images in one collection of film negatives at the time it was prepared. The 78 items seized should not be mistaken for 78 confirmed images. The criminal complaint sets out allegations supporting the charge; it is not a finding of guilt.
Arrested at Florida care facility
Markle was arrested in Lakeland, Florida, where he had been living after returning from the Philippines earlier this year. He appeared before a federal magistrate in Tampa on Friday and did not enter a plea. He was released on bond and returned to his assisted-living facility under home detention and electronic monitoring. Conditions also restrict his travel and access to internet-connected devices, according to reports of the court hearing.
He is required to undergo health evaluations. The case is expected to proceed in California, where the charge was filed. If convicted, Markle could face a maximum sentence of 20 years in federal prison. He is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty in court. The US Department of Justice has stressed that the complaint contains allegations only.
Meghan said she kept her children away to protect them
The arrest follows weeks of reports about the investigation in the Philippines, where Markle had been living. The Associated Press reported that Meghan’s half-brother, Thomas Markle Jr, found a collection of suspected abuse images while clearing out their father’s former home in Cebu City and contacted police and the FBI. Markle previously denied the accusations, describing them as “sick lies”, according to Reuters. Meghan said she was “deeply distressed” by the allegations and referred to a letter sent to London police in 2018 which contained what she described as troubling claims about her father.
She said she had been assured the allegations were being investigated. Meghan also addressed years of speculation about the estrangement, saying her decision to keep her father away from her and her children had been made to protect them. There has been no public comment from Meghan’s representative on Friday’s arrest. The FBI investigation remains active, while the criminal case will determine whether the allegations can be proved in court.

Thomas Markle Arrested on Federal Child Pornography Charge
sources.text:
Thomas Markle, the estranged father of Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, was arrested in Florida on a federal child pornography charge after agents seized suspected images from California storage units, and prosecutors say they will pursue the case fully.
The Justice Department announced that the 82-year-old retired television lighting director faces one count of possession of child pornography, according to a criminal complaint. NBC News reported the arrest and his first court appearance Friday afternoon in Tampa.
Markle arrived at the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida in a wheelchair pushed by a deputy U.S. marshal. U.S. Magistrate Judge Lindsay S. Griffin read the charges and ordered that he receive a copy. He was later released under house arrest after a bond hearing, local outlets said.
He has been living in a senior care facility in Lakeland after returning to the United States from the Philippines following a stroke and a leg amputation. A spokesperson for Prince Harry and Meghan declined to comment on the arrest. Buckingham Palace did not respond to a request for comment.
Court documents describe how the FBI took about 78 items from two storage units Markle had rented in California since the summer of 2008. Agents seized 27 items from one unit and 51 from the other. The haul included film negatives, books, and slides that authorities said contained suspected child pornography. Some material is still under review.
The complaint states that at least 18 images made from converted negatives appeared to constitute child pornography. At least two images showed a clothed adult man with a nude female child. A witness positively identified the adult man as Markle, the FBI said. Based on the background in one photo, agents determined some images were taken in a hotel in the Philippines. The bureau also found that some of the seized film was manufactured in New York, which it cited as a basis for interstate commerce.
First Assistant U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli framed the case in blunt terms.
"These allegations are extremely serious, and we will prosecute Mr. Markle to the fullest extent of federal law,"
FBI Director Kash Patel said agents moved fast with Justice Department partners.
"Working with our Justice Department partners, our agents moved quickly, identified and located the explicit material, and arrested Mr. Markle in Florida,"
Weeks before the Florida arrest, authorities in the Philippines said they were investigating claims that Markle kept child sexual abuse images at his home there. They later said they had recovered thousands of photos featuring underage males and females. Last month, Markle denied those allegations and called them “sick lies.”
The U.S. charge remains an allegation. No conviction is on the record in the reporting available on this arrest. The complaint language and the earlier overseas claims sit side by side with his denial, and the courts will sort the evidence.
British police confirmed that in January 2019 Meghan was passed a letter “containing a number of claims about alleged offending outside the United Kingdom.” London’s Metropolitan Police said it had not informed other law enforcement agencies about those allegations at the time and later referred itself to Britain’s policing watchdog.
Last month, as the Philippines reports surfaced, Meghan said she was “deeply distressed” and that she had previously been informed of “disturbing allegations.” She went further in her own words.
"The breadth of what has now been uncovered is more sickening than one could ever imagine,"
She said she kept her children, Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5, away from her father “for one reason: to protect them.” That choice now reads as a parent drawing a hard line long before federal agents rolled up storage units in California.
Harry and Meghan stepped back as working royals in 2020 and left Britain for California. This summer they moved back toward Britain, and the children have been shifting into schools there. Two months ago the couple was again on British soil as their public life reset after years away.
Their return has drawn steady attention, including a recent sighting hand-in-hand at a Cotswolds pub after the U.K. move. The Florida case lands on a family already managing estrangement, security, and a very public break with royal life.
Separate from the criminal case, Meghan has spent years trying to rebuild a screen career after royal life. Reports have tracked early talks tied to a Netflix series and other reinvention bids that have drawn mixed results. Those projects are entertainment news. This arrest is not.
Federal possession charges involving images of minors are among the most serious non-violent crimes on the books because they document real abuse and create lasting harm to victims. The complaint’s description of film negatives, a witness identification, and material tied to a hotel overseas is the kind of paper trail prosecutors use to take a case to trial. Essayli’s promise to prosecute “to the fullest extent of federal law” matches that gravity.
Markle did not attend his daughter’s 2018 wedding amid heavy media pressure. The family rupture was already public. What the storage-unit seizures and the Philippines claims add is a criminal dimension that no amount of palace silence or celebrity branding can paper over. Readers who have followed Meghan’s uneven post-royal reinvention efforts know the couple’s media strategy well; none of that strategy answers a federal complaint.
House arrest in a Florida senior facility is not the end of the matter. It is the start of a prosecution. The charge is possession of child pornography. The evidence, as described in court papers, includes images a witness tied directly to Markle and film that crossed state lines. Those are facts a jury can weigh.
Parents who cut off contact to shield small children from a relative under a cloud made a judgment call the law now has a chance to test with evidence, not headlines. Accountability for anyone alleged to traffic in images of abused children is not optional, famous surname or not.

Meghan Markle's father arrested and charged with possessing child sexual abuse material
Thomas Markle arrested over allegations he possessed child sex abuse material
sources.text:
The Duchess of Sussex’s father Thomas Markle Sr has been charged over alleged possession of child abuse material, including images of himself with young girls.
Read More
Markle Sr, 82, who is charged with one count of possession of child pornography, appeared in court in Tampa, Florida, on Friday.
The seized material was allegedly found in two Los Angeles storage units he rented for nearly two decades.
Markle Sr, of Lakeland, Florida, was taken into custody in Florida by FBI agents on Thursday.
The seized material was allegedly found in two Los Angeles storage units he rented for nearly two decades.
Acting on warrants, the FBI searched the storage units registered to Markle Sr which he had rented since 2008, with his most recent payments on both made last month by auto-pay.
Inside the units, agents seized about 78 items, including slides, film negatives, and books that contained suspected child sex abuse material.
Two of the images allegedly depict an adult man – whom a witness “positively identified” as Markle Sr– with a nude young girl.
In one of them, according to court documents, the man “appears to be in the age range of 30s to 40s”, which suggests the alleged abuse dates back decades given Markle Sr is now 82.
A third image is said to show a nude young girl in a room that appears to be part of a motel chain in the Philippines.
Other photographs allegedly show Markle Sr with children in various stages of undress.
If convicted, he would face at least 20 years in federal prison.
First assistant US attorney Bill Essayli said: “Mr Markle is accused of possessing child sexual abuse material, including photographs depicting himself with minor girls.
“These allegations are extremely serious, and we will prosecute Mr Markle to the fullest extent of federal law.”
FBI director Kash Patel said: “The FBI and our partners have arrested Thomas Markle Sr after an FBI investigation revealed he was in possession of child sexual abuse material.
“Mr Markle allegedly targeted innocent children and sought to steal their innocence through his criminal actions.
“Working with our Justice Department partners, our agents moved quickly, identified and located the explicit material, and arrested Mr Markle in Florida.
“This FBI will use every single resource at our disposal to protect innocent kids – any predator who targets children will have zero safe haven in this country or anywhere they try to hide.
“Thank-you to FBI Los Angeles, FBI Tampa, our Mexico and Marshall Islands law enforcement attaches, and our partners who executed quickly in this case.”
Patrick Grandy, the assistant director in charge of the FBI’s Los Angeles field office, said: “This case highlights the importance of the involvement of the public, even if it’s a family member or close friend, to be vigilant and speak up if they have information on individuals they suspect may be preying on and exploiting our children.”
His detention comes after he was reported to police in the Philippines and the FBI last month by his son, Thomas Markle Jnr after he allegedly found illegal images in his father’s belongings in Cebu City.
Earlier this month it was reported that hundreds of images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Markle, 82, had been found at a property in the Philippines.
Markle Sr previously denied the allegations, describing them as "sick lies".
A second hoard was reportedly discovered last week in a storage unit Mr Markle Sr is said to have rented near his former home in Rosarito, Mexico, during a raid by police.
Mr Markle Sr, who was living in a dementia care home in the US, has admitted to paying for sex in the Philippines but has denied ever possessing child abuse imagery.
Meghan, who moved back to the UK with Harry in August, said she was “deeply distressed” at the allegations about her father, from whom she has been estranged since the run-up to her 2018 wedding.
She revealed she was sent a letter via the Metropolitan Police and Royalty and Specialist Protection in 2019 which made “troubling and disturbing allegations” about her father, but that she was given assurances these were being investigated.
The Met has admitted it never shared the details with other law enforcement agencies, with the police watchdog, the Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC), now investigating the force’s conduct.
The duchess had wanted to “speak out” immediately after reading the letter but police advised her against this, sources said.
When former TV lighting director Mr Markle had his leg amputated in the Philippines last year, he made pleas for the duchess to contact him.
Meghan is said to have written him a final letter in which she said she knew he was an abuser and that he would never see his grandchildren Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet.

sources.text:
Thomas Markle, babai i Meghan Markle, është arrestuar nga FBI-ja në kuadër të një hetimi mbi materiale të abuzimit seksual me fëmijë, sipas një raportimi ekskluziv të Daily Mail. Dukesha e Sussex i ka ndërprerë prej vitesh të gjitha kontaktet me të.
Hetimet po zhvillohen në Shtetet e Bashkuara, Meksikë dhe Filipine, ku autoritetet po shqyrtojnë materiale të zbuluara në ambiente në të cilat Markle kishte banuar ose ruante sende personale.
Të lidhura
None found
Sipas raportimit, agjentët federalë kontrolluan qendrën për të moshuarit Maravida, në Lakeland të Floridës, ku ai jeton. Ndërhyrja pasoi zbulimin gjatë javëve të fundit të sasive të mëdha materialesh të papërshtatshme në prona të lidhura me të në Meksikë dhe Filipine. Një burim i Daily Mail deklaroi se arrestimi ishte kryer për posedim të Materialeve të Abuzimit Seksual me Fëmijë, të njohura si CSAM.
Autoritetet federale amerikane ishin njoftuar vetëm disa ditë përpara arrestimit për materiale të tilla të gjetura në një depo të marrë me qira nga Markle, pranë banesës së tij të dikurshme në Rosarito të Meksikës. Paralelisht, policia filipinase raportohet se po i afrohet ngritjes së akuzave zyrtare, pas zbulimit muajin e kaluar të imazheve të abuzimit seksual me fëmijë në ish-shtëpinë e tij atje.
Kontrolli i depos në Rosarito
Hetimi në Meksikë u zgjerua me një bastisje në depon e Rosaritos. Në objektin që ndodhet rreth tre milje nga ish-banesa e Markle në qytetin bregdetar hynë efektivë të Gardës Kombëtare Meksikane.
Pjesë e grupit ishin specialistë të forenzikës dixhitale, një hetues sinjalistike dhe përfaqësues të zyrës së prokurorit të përgjithshëm të shtetit Baja California. Ata përdorën fenerë për të shqyrtuar kutitë që ndodheshin brenda. Një dëshmitar tregoi se një agjent u trondit dukshëm kur pa materialet dhe shqiptoi “Ay cabrón”, shprehje spanjolle që mund të jepet në shqip si “O Zot!” ose “Çfarë dreqin!”.
Dokumenti që autorizonte kontrollin tregon se hetuesit kishin siguruar miratimin e gjykatës për të kërkuar prova të materialeve të abuzimit seksual me fëmijë. Autorizimi përfshinte edhe prova për kryerjen e dyshuar të trafikimit të qenieve njerëzore në rrethana rënduese.
Sipas një burimi, gjatë operacionit u kontrolluan dhe u sekuestruan një kompjuter, pajisje ruajtjeje USB, videokaseta VHS dhe një grumbull revistash, krahas sendeve të tjera. Në përfundim, autoritetet e vulosën objektin dhe vendosën njoftimin zyrtar të sekuestrimit.
Babai i Dukeshës së Sussex e kishte marrë me qira magazinën 22 në vitin 2017. Pagesat e qirasë ishin ndërprerë dy vjet më parë, ndërsa ambienti nuk ishte zbrazur përpara largimit të tij drejt Filipineve në fillim të vitit 2025.
Pronari i biznesit dhe punonjësit deklaruan se nuk kishin dijeni për sendet e ruajtura në magazinë dhe u shprehën të tmerruar nga zbulimi. Kur informacionet për materialet dolën fillimisht në publik, Markle kundërshtoi prerazi çdo përfshirje në veprimtari të paligjshme. Në deklaratën për Daily Mail, ai mohoi se kishte pasur magazinë në Rosarito.
Çfarë përmbanin ambientet e kontrolluara
Mes sendeve ndodheshin kujtime familjare, letra dhe fotografi pa përmbajtje të dyshimtë. Por në depo kishte gjithashtu fotografi bardh e zi të grave aziatike të zhveshura, disa prej të cilave dukeshin shumë të reja, si edhe libra e revista që paraqisnin fëmijë në mënyrë të papërshtatshme, duke përdorur për ta përshkrimin “Lolita”.
U zbuluan edhe shirita negativësh fotografikë 35 mm, ku shfaqeshin fëmijë në një plazh. Ndër videokasetat e vjetra VHS kishte tituj si “Djemtë, Vëllai dhe Motra – Russian XX” dhe “Manila Nites”.
Në të njëjtën zonë u gjetën kompjuterë të vjetër dhe disqe të ngurtë. Mes sendeve ishte edhe një pjatë letre, në të cilën ishin shënuar me bojë të kuqe fjalët “DARK WEB” dhe disa adresa interneti.
Autorizimi gjyqësor dhe koordinimi me FBI-në
Në këtë çështje janë angazhuar edhe agjentë të FBI-së të vendosur në Kaliforninë Jugore, të cilët mbulojnë koordinimin me agjencitë ligjzbatuese në jug të kufirit amerikan.
Sipas urdhrit të kontrollit, kërkesa e prokurorëve meksikanë iu paraqit gjyqtarit Estefani Moreno Gutierrez të Autoritetit Gjyqësor të Baja California, gjatë një takimi me dyer të mbyllura më 30 tetor.
Dokumenti përcaktonte se ndërhyrja kishte si qëllim të vetëm kërkimin, gjetjen dhe sigurimin e provave të materialeve të abuzimit seksual me fëmijë. Në të përfshiheshin materiale të shtypura, pajisje USB dhe karta memorieje nga aparate fotografike apo telefona celularë.
Hetuesve u kërkohej gjithashtu të identifikonin pajisjet e komunikimit dhe ato elektronike ku mund të ruheshin video me përmbajtje seksuale eksplicite, përfshirë celularë, laptopë, kompjuterë dhe tableta.
Markle ishte vendosur në Rosarito në vitin 2011. Zona e qetë bregdetare njihet si destinacion për pensionistët amerikanë. Gjatë qëndrimit atje u prish marrëdhënia e tij me të bijën, Meghan, Dukeshën e Sussex. Në fillim të vitit 2025, ai u largua nga Meksika për t’u zhvendosur në Filipine.
Hetimi i veçantë në Filipine
Në vendin e Azisë Juglindore po vijon një procedim më vete, i nisur pas pretendimeve të djalit të Markle. Ai tha se kishte zbuluar qindra, në mos mijëra, imazhe të abuzimit seksual me fëmijë në kutitë që i ati kishte sjellë në Filipine.
Më pas, policia e Cebu City konfirmoi gjetjen e përmbajtjes seksuale eksplicite në pajisje dixhitale që ndodheshin mes sendeve personale. Sipas saj, materialet përfshinin video me vajza dhe djem të mitur.
Markle i hodhi poshtë raportimet që e lidhnin me pornografi të dyshuar me fëmijë në Filipine, duke i cilësuar si gënjeshtra të sëmura të sajuara nga djali i tij.
Ai pranoi se në atë vend kishte paguar për shërbime seksuale, por këmbënguli se nuk kishte kryer asnjëherë marrëdhënie seksuale me persona nën 18 vjeç. Këtë mohim e përsëriti në deklaratën e dhënë Daily Mail javën e kaluar, duke shtuar se pëlqimi i tij për gratë aziatike nuk përbën krim.
Qëndrimi i Dukeshës së Sussex
Pas publikimit të akuzave, Meghan Markle u shpreh thellësisht e tronditur nga informacionet e bëra të ditura. Duke iu referuar hetimit që vijon në Filipine, ajo tha se mendimet e saj shkonin te çdo fëmijë që mund të kishte pësuar abuzim.
Bashkëshortja e Princit Harry ishte njohur për herë të parë me akuza ndaj të atit në vitin 2019, kur iu përcoll një letër nga Policia Metropolitane e Londrës.
Letra dyshohet se ishte dërguar nga Rosalynn Lovelace, bashkëshortja e parë e Markle, tashmë e ndjerë. Në të pretendohej se ai kishte pranuar udhëtime në Lindjen e Largët me qëllim kryerjen e marrëdhënieve seksuale me vajza të mitura.
Sipas informacionit për përmbajtjen e letrës, Lovelace shkruante se e kishte pyetur Thomas për akuzën dhe se ai e kishte mohuar. Megjithatë, ajo pretendonte se ai kishte thënë se udhëtonte në Filipine dhe Tajlandë sepse atje marrëdhëniet me 12-vjeçarë ishin të ligjshme. Kjo deklaratë mbetet një pretendim i përfshirë në letër, jo një fakt i verifikuar dhe as një paraqitje e saktë e legjislacionit të këtyre vendeve.
